_readme: Said only once the oil is in hand: the map's object requires lamp_oil and consumes
it, so reaching this line is itself the proof the player found the hermit.

pour.speaker: The keep
pour.text: You pour the flask in. The wick drinks it and stiffens.

light.speaker: The keep
light.text: It catches on the second try. The room is suddenly a room, rather than a shape in the dark.
